known.via: English Wikipedia "Costa de Cantabria" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A vino de la tierra on Spain's north coast, covering Cantabrian municipalities between the sea and the Picos de Europa mountains. It leaves out the towns covered by Liébana. It sits one step below the DO level.
